title: Implement authority and lifecycle handoff previews
goal: Project Profile Plan Module and immutable lifecycle next steps without adding an apply or raw-command surface.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile Plan and Module items use Host-derived identities and declare exact availability and next boundaries.
Lifecycle preview distinguishes verify compose select rollback retention and remote activation without performing them.
Unavailable M4/M5 or Target-trust capabilities remain explicit handoffs and cannot be invoked.
No browser-controlled path command environment Target write installation selection cleanup Git or remote operation exists.
risks: A preview or handoff could be mistaken for applied or authorized lifecycle state.
decisions: Return descriptive Host-owned next operations and keep every apply capability unavailable.
